target_customer: Early stage startup founders who need banking, payroll, bookkeeping and tax in one place
problem: Founders lose time and make errors stitching together separate back office vendors for banking, payroll, benefits, bookkeeping and taxes.
business_model: Software and services subscription bundle plus banking interchange through a partner bank
product_category: Startup back office, fintech and HR suite

founders.name: Rajeev Behera
previous_startups: Reflektive (co-founder and CEO; raised about 100 million dollars and grew to 250 employees per the YC page)
founders.background_notes: Education not found in opened sources.

founders.name: Barry Peterson
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page with no background.

technical_complexity.rationale: Standard fintech engineering, with the harder parts being multi state payroll, tax filing and bank partner integration, handled through partners such as a sponsor bank.

defensibility.rationale: A bundle of banking, payroll and books creates some switching cost, but each part has strong standalone rivals and the bank is a partner.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals expanded across the bundle over time; Every kept growing and was named to Fast Company most innovative list in 2025 per its site.

market_need_then: The seed coverage says the idea came from the founder's own errors setting up a back office. Press reported 1 million dollars ARR in six months and 75 customers at the seed announcement.

branding.domain_note: Operates at every.io, not an exact .com; no purchase history found.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Short, confident and direct, for example your entire back office in one place.

branding.brand_signature: The all in one pitch of everything in one place
branding.community_and_virality: Runs a founders guide called Blueprint on its site; no merch or fan evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: The name is a generic common word that fits the one place promise but is hard to search; no press on the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Every launched out of YC in 2023 and reported 1 million dollars ARR in six months before announcing a 9.5 million dollar seed led by Base10 in November 2023. The YC page later cites about 2,100 customers including over 300 YC startups. A repeat founder who scaled Reflektive to 250 staff brings fundraising credibility and domain exposure. The risk is competition from larger payroll and banking vendors, with no later round found.
notes: Seed amount confirmed by Axios, SiliconANGLE and a press release listing; investor split is from outlets. No later round was searched beyond the seed coverage and none appeared. Competitor sources were all 2025 market summaries or the company's own blog, not dated near 2023, so the list is empty. The YC page says founded 2021.
